# Kodus

> > Open source AI code review platform featuring Kody, a model-agnostic code reviewer supporting GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket with custom rules and team-specific standards enforcement.

Kodus provides an alternative to CodeRabbit with support for multiple AI models (Claude, GPT, Llama, Mistral) and integrations with popular developer tools like Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, Jira, Linear, and Notion. The platform offers automated PR reviews, custom rule generation, and DORA metrics tracking for engineering teams.

## Key Topics

- AI Code Review
- Kody (AI code reviewer agent)
- Model-agnostic (Claude, GPT, Llama, Mistral)
- Pull Request Automation
- Custom Review Rules
- Git Integration (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket)
- IDE Integration (Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf)
- Code Quality & Technical Debt
- DORA Metrics
- Open Source & Self-hosted
- Developer Productivity
- Engineering Culture & Best Practices
- BYOK (Bring Your Own Key)
- SOC 2 Compliance

- [Kodus Homepage](https://kodus.io): Homepage: Open source CodeRabbit alternative with model choice control
- [AI Code Review Product](https://kodus.io/en/ai-code-review): AI code review product page emphasizing open source and customization
- [Sign Up](https://app.kodus.io/sign-up): Registration page for teams to start using Kody code reviews
- [Login](https://app.kodus.io): User login page for Kodus app authentication
- [Pricing](https://kodus.io/pricing): Pricing plans: Community free tier, Pro, Enterprise with BYOK options
- [Customers](https://kodus.io/customers): Case studies from Brendi, Conta Voltz, Doji showing 70% review time saved

## Code Review Documentation

- [Code Review Flow](https://docs.kodus.io/how_to_use/en/code_review/flow): PR review workflow: when Kody runs, skips, and posts inline comments
- [Review Policy](https://docs.kodus.io/how_to_use/en/code_review/policy): Kody feedback interpretation: suggestions, blocking reviews, auto-approve
- [Workspace Roles](https://docs.kodus.io/how_to_use/en/workspace_roles): RBAC guide: workspace member roles vs PR license management in Kodus
- [Automatic Rule Generation](https://docs.kodus.io/knowledge_base/en/how-to-generate-rules-automatically): AI-powered rule generation from 3 months of team review history patterns
- [Novita AI Integration](https://docs.kodus.io/cookbook/en/novita): Integration guide for Novita AI serverless GPU with Llama, Mistral, Claude
